tasks.short: Measure and verify excavated material levels

steps.what: Check the authorised target levels, reference points and tolerances for the rock, gravel or excavated base
inputs: survey-team issued location, reference datum, target levels, tolerances and plan revision
outputs: checked target-level reference for the work area

steps.what: Position the measuring equipment, confirm the reference and measure actual levels of rock, gravel, bases or excavated material
inputs: checked target-level reference for the work area
actual work area and measuring equipment
outputs: actual instrument readings with checked location and datum

steps.what: Compare actual readings with the target levels and calculate level differences
inputs: actual instrument readings with checked location and datum
checked target-level reference for the work area

steps.what: Verify measured material levels against the physical conditions and tolerances, repeating suspect measurements
inputs: actual work area and physical reference conditions
outputs: operator-verified level condition or explicit need for remeasurement

tasks.design: Configure the current work-area plan view in the {OPS_SYSTEM} and the target-difference display of the {OTHER} electronic level or survey instrument. The operator checks datum and location, takes actual measurements and verifies their physical plausibility; the instrument only compares known numbers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable target and comparing readings can interrupt physical measurement; existing instrumentation may already perform these calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native plan filters and a supported target-difference function can reduce lookup and arithmetic without replacing measurement.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect reference setup, unstable material and misleading readings require physical checking.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the instrument reading conflicts with site conditions and repeat the measurement.

ambition.what: No new service or authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for authorised plans and instrument configuration; consult operators about the changed display

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: some electronic surveying instruments can compare actual readings with entered target levels; availability depends on the installed equipment.

assumptions: Boundary is measuring and verifying levels, not excavation, a formal survey report or sending results. No extra reporting baseline is invented; if an actual required record or handoff exists, it must be measured and split separately.

Survey staff already issue work-area id, plan revision, datum, target and tolerance. The operator checks these in s1 and enters or confirms required target values during s2; no free structured target or instrument-reading capture is assumed.

OTHER is the installed electronic level or survey instrument. s2 retains all positioning, target setup and actual reading capture. s3 only calculates differences from those readings; no model interprets terrain.
Test native functions first. No automatic level-file save, report or message is proposed. If the instrument lacks this function or already shows differences, remove the associated claimed gain.
All shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines; physical work stays fully retained and machine runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Installed instrument capabilities and existing target display
Availability and format of authorised target plans
research_questions: Can the operator trace a displayed difference to the correct datum and plan revision?
Does the native display remove arithmetic while preserving independent measurement checks?

already_counted.description: Check displayed differences against the known target and units

incremental.description: Check target-display settings and plan-filter mappings when plans or equipment change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 13.8 minus 1 upkeep gives 12.8. High allows 4.8 additional hours resolving plan and instrument exceptions; low applies when native functions already cover the work or are unavailable.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct ground workers moving markers or changing tower positions

steps.what: Check the current work plan and authorised stake, marker or tower positions before directing ground workers
inputs: site-team issued current work-area plan with positions, revision and restrictions

steps.what: Assess actual ground-worker locations, visibility and the positioning activity before giving directions
inputs: actual workers, site conditions and equipment positions

steps.what: Direct ground workers engaged in moving stakes or markers or changing tower positions and confirm their understanding in the live exchange
inputs: actual ground workers and their responses
outputs: actual live directions and worker understanding or unresolved coordination

steps.what: Observe actual positioning outcomes and clarify any discrepancy with the ground workers
inputs: actual live directions and worker understanding or unresolved coordination
actual resulting marker, stake or tower positions
outputs: operator-confirmed positioning outcome or further live correction

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} to show the current authorised positioning plan for the selected work area. The operator still assesses the scene, directs workers in a live exchange and checks the actual outcome; the software supplies a reference rather than issuing commands.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right plan revision can take attention away from site coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: A native work-area filter can make the applicable plan easier to locate.
tasks.still_hard: Visibility, changing positions and misunderstandings require immediate human coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Notice hesitation or an unsafe mismatch between an intended move and the actual scene.

ambition.what: No change in command authority or additional service is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for plan access and consultation with site operators

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operational plan views can filter documents by work area and current revision.

assumptions: Boundary includes plan lookup, operator assessment, live directions and confirmation. Ground workers' actual movement is other-role work outside the focal denominator and receives no saving.

The site team already supplies work-area id, approved positions, plan revision and restrictions. Missing or ambiguous references are checked manually in s1; no free map extraction or worker-location feed is assumed.

Native configuration first. Live spoken direction remains fully human and is not an automated send. No message, committed movement instruction or report is proposed; if a site actually requires one, split and measure that work with its own final-version gate.
All shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. No new record-writing baseline is assumed and no field coordination time is reduced.
unknowns: Whether an accessible current-plan view already exists
Actual time spent finding plans during this task
research_questions: Does a work-area filter reduce lookup without hiding revision or restriction information?
Is lookup a meaningful part of actual operator time?

already_counted.description: Check the selected plan revision and restrictions

incremental.description: Check the work-area plan filter when plan metadata changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 4.8 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 4.3. High allows 1.3 additional hours checking ambiguous plan references; low applies when the current plan is already immediately available.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The operator can spend less attention finding plan references and calculating known level differences; physical verification and live coordination remain the work.
skills_to_grow: Recognise when displayed information conflicts with the site
role.ambitious_version: Use clearer references to support careful field judgement without transferring control of measurement or ground-worker direction to software.

job.title: Excavating and Loading Machine and Dragline Operators, Surface Mining
